action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/backend/routes/token.py:token_wallet, always project spent_total (default 0.0) into the response for consistency — currently absent when the user's token_accounts doc predates any spend.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/token.py & routes/swarm.py are clean, well-documented, use async/await, exclude _id, all env-driven — no issues.
swarm agents are idempotent per-day (deterministic sha256 luck) and daily caps are respected — good.

fortress.tsx & token.tsx: all interactive elements have testID, correct SafeAreaView usage, all text wrapped in <Text>, StyleSheet.create used, no deprecated packages — clean React Native code.
